notes.notes:

[b]Banker Simulator Early Access goes live tomorrow! 🎉[/b][/p][p]📆 [b]Release Date:[/b]
September 22, 2025 – 19:00 GMT+3 / 18:00 CEST / 16:00 GMT[/p][previewyoutube="P8GNAo2Vq3w;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The countdown is nearly over.
